sloka: अपापः पापसङ्कल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले ।लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देव तामिव ॥२-१०-२४॥
transliteration: apāpaḥ pāpasaṅkalpāṁ dadarśa dharaṇītale ।latāmiva viniṣkṛttāṁ patitāṁ deva tāmiva ॥2-10-24॥

translations.english: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.
translations.hindi: शुद्ध हृदय महाराज दशरथ दीन हो विलाप करते ए रोने लगे । रोते-रोतेः उनकी दोनों आँखे लाल हो गइ, किन्तु इरान 5 और धमकी से भरे हुए उनके करुण बिलाप पर उस दृष्टा कैकेयी ने कुछ भी ध्यान न दिया
